note: ClearPotential (arXiv:2512.09989) ensemble-mean gravitational potential on a Sun-centred 64^3 grid inside the 3.8 kpc analysis sphere. Source: a direct dump of the ensemble-mean potential (160^3, 50 pc cells, 4 kpc sphere). Built by build_grid.py (trilinear resampling of the dump, no smoothing). Checked against the published midplane grid (see midplane_check).
units: Phi in 1e5 (km/s)^2; phi = phi_min + q/(2^bits - 1) * (phi_max - phi_min)
axes: x toward the Galactic anti-centre, y along Galactic rotation, z up; Sun at the origin
layout: x-lines, line id = iz*n + iy; lines = [i0, m] uint8; head = [q(i0), q(i0+1)] uint16 LE; res = int8 second differences of the other valid voxels; the decoder continues each line linearly outside its valid part
